sources.quote: In 1920 Beirut and other coastal towns, Bekaa, and certain other districts were added to the autonomous territory Mount Lebanon as defined in 1861 to form Greater Lebanon

notes.en: The Israeli incursion of March 1978 (which led to UNSC res. 425 and UNIFIL) and the civil war are not modelled.

description.en: Lebanon minus the Israeli-held south (to Beirut in 1982; the 'security zone' after 1985).
description.ar: لبنان من دون الجنوب الذي تحتله إسرائيل (حتى بيروت عام 1982؛ و'المنطقة الأمنية' بعد 1985).
description.he: לבנון ללא הדרום שבידי ישראל (עד ביירות ב-1982; “רצועת הביטחון” לאחר 1985).

sources.quote: In 1985, Israel carried out a partial withdrawal, but it retained control of an area in southern Lebanon

notes.en: Syrian forces were also present in much of Lebanon in this period; not modelled. Modelling note: drawn as the whole of Lebanon; the Israeli-held south is a separate record (israeli-occupied-zone-south-lebanon-1982) drawn on top.

description.en: Lebanon after the Israeli withdrawal to the UN-identified Blue Line (2000). From 2024, and much more from March 2026, Israel held positions and a security zone in the south (separate record).
description.ar: لبنان بعد الانسحاب الإسرائيلي إلى الخط الأزرق الذي حددته الأمم المتحدة (2000). ومنذ 2024، وأكثر بكثير منذ آذار/مارس 2026، أبقت إسرائيل مواقع ومنطقة أمنية في الجنوب (سجل منفصل).
description.he: לבנון לאחר הנסיגה הישראלית לקו הכחול שזיהה האו״ם (2000). מ-2024, ובהרבה יותר מאז מרץ 2026, החזיקה ישראל בעמדות ובאזור ביטחון בדרום (רשומה נפרדת).

sources.quote: On 16 June, the Secretary-General reported to the Security Council that Israel had withdrawn its forces from Lebanon in accordance with resolution 425 (1978)

notes.en: Overlaps with israeli-security-zone-south-lebanon-2024 from 2024; Lebanon's sovereignty claim covers the whole unit. Modelling note: the Israeli-held positions since 2024 are a separate record drawn on top.
